PostHog session replay, gated to /docs/reference/* only

Why: skill and hook reference pages bounce at about 100% and events alone cannot say why. This page mirrors the gate in docs/site/lib/replay-gate.ts. Try a path and toggle the privacy layers to see what a recording would contain.

Path

Privacy layers (all on in the PR)

Unchecking a layer shows what would leak without it. The PR ships with every layer on.

Result

CSP change (next.config.mjs)

+ "worker-src 'self' blob:",
  script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'   (unchanged)

The replay recorder starts a Web Worker from a blob: URL. Without worker-src the browser falls back to script-src, which has no blob:, and refuses it. Only workers get blob:.

Limits

Nothing records until session replay is enabled in the PostHog project settings (the SDK needs that server side flag too). No URL trigger is configured in the project, so the in-code gate is the only path filter. Public page text on reference pages is recorded.
